title: Jones Beach Energy & Nature Center

services.name: audio tour
services.desc: There are two free audio tours that can guide you as you explore the Center. Both tours are accessible from your mobile device. The Power of Nature. This is a 15-minute, playful introduction to the exhibits. Net-Zero Building. This 30-minute tour gives a more advanced overview of the net-zero energy features of this building. The audio tours are available in English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, American Sign Language, and English-language audio description for the visually impaired. We thank the Long Island Community Foundation for their generous support, which made these audio tours possible. Jones Beach State Park West End 2 150 Bay ParkwayWantagh, NY 11793Driving

services.name: Room Rentals
services.desc: Thank you for your interest in hosting an event/renting a room at the Center. During the day, we can rent out our Multipurpose Room for private business events for up to 60 people. Depending on availability, the smaller Energy Classroom is also available for use. For an additional fee, after-hour events can make use of the whole building. Unfortunately, the Center does not host birthday parties, weddings, or personal gatherings. Jones Beach State Park West End 2 150 Bay ParkwayWantagh, NY 11793Driving

services.name: Cancelled- Fishing Clinic
services.desc: Join an educator and learn about the fish that live in Jones Bay with our free rod and reel fishing clinic. Outdoors/Indoors?: Outdoors. Will be cancelled via email in the case of inclement weather. Jones Beach State Park West End 2 150 Bay ParkwayWantagh, NY 11793Driving
